tasks.n: Assemble four gift baskets
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a house must assemble four gift baskets in the living room by taking a candle, a butter cookie, a piece of Swiss cheese and a bow from the table and placing one of each into every wicker basket on the floor. With sixteen small items to share out evenly among four containers, the challenge is a long, repetitive sequence of placements without duplicates or omissions.

tasks.n: Attach a camera to a tripod
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must pick up a digital camera and a camera tripod lying on the floor and join them so that the camera is mounted on the tripod. The two parts only snap together when their attachment points are brought close enough together and roughly aligned, so success depends on careful orientation and placement.

tasks.n: Box up books for storage
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must collect six books standing in four different bookcases and put all of them into an empty box on the floor. The bookcases and the box are spread across the room, so the robot has to drive back and forth many times through a long sequence of grasps and placements.

tasks.n: Pack up tacos after dinner
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must clear up after dinner: take an empty tupperware out of a closed cabinet, put two tacos from plates on the counter into it, place the tupperware in the refrigerator, and move both plates to the sink, leaving the refrigerator shut. Several dependent steps and two doors to handle mean the order of actions matters.

tasks.n: Take paper out to recycling
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must take a sack from the kitchen floor and a newspaper from the countertop out to the recycling bin in the garden, put both inside, and close the bin. Besides the long drive between rooms, the bin must be opened before filling and closed afterwards, so the steps depend on one another.

tasks.n: Bring water bottles from the fridge
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must open the kitchen refrigerator, take out both bottles, close the door again and carry the bottles to the coffee table in the living room. The fridge has to be opened to reach the bottles yet end up shut, and the goal is in a different room, so the steps are ordered and the robot must drive between rooms.

tasks.n: Bring plywood in from the garden
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must carry three sheets of plywood lying on the ground in the garden into the house and put them on the corridor floor. The sheets and their destination are in different places, so the robot has to drive a long way while moving large flat objects one after another.

tasks.n: Can sausages in hinged jars
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must open a cabinet, take out two hinged jars, put exactly two cooked bratwursts into each, close the jars, return them to the cabinet and shut it. Both the jar lids and the cabinet door need handling and the count per jar must be right, which makes this a long dependent chain.

tasks.n: Dice and store steak and pineapple
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must fetch a steak and a pineapple from the refrigerator, dice both with a carving knife, fill one bowl with only diced steak and another with only diced pineapple, and store the bowls in a cabinet with the doors closed. Dicing produces simulated particles that must be gathered without mixing the two foods, over a long chain of steps.

tasks.n: Carry garden furniture out of the house
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must move a lawn chair and a wheelbarrow from the living-room floor out to the garden, placing the chair on the garden floor and the wheelbarrow on a lawn. Both items are bulky, and the robot has to drive a long way between the house and the garden to deliver them.

tasks.n: Bring groceries in from the car
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must unload a sack from an open car in the garage, bring a tomato and a carton of milk to the kitchen refrigerator and put them inside. The car and the refrigerator both have to be closed at the end, and the two places are far apart, so the robot needs a long ordered sequence of driving, opening and closing.

tasks.n: Dice an onion into a bowl
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take an onion from the sink, dice it on a chopping board with a paring knife, move the diced pieces into a bowl, and finally put the knife and the board into the sink. The dicing creates simulated particles that must end up in the bowl, and the order of steps matters.

tasks.n: Split firewood logs with an axe
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator on a garden driveway must use an axe, with a chopping block at hand, to split four logs in half. The logs are spread out along the driveway, so the robot has to move between them while wielding the axe accurately enough to cut each one.

tasks.n: Clean dust off a keyboard
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a private office must clean a dusty keyboard on the desk with a pipe cleaner, leaving no dust at all. Dust only comes off through sustained contact of the tool over the keys, so the robot has to cover the whole keyboard thoroughly with a thin tool.

tasks.n: Clean boxing gloves in the washer
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a utility room must get two dusty boxing gloves clean. The only cleaning means in the scene is the washer, so the robot has to recognise this, open the washer, load both gloves from the countertop, close the door and switch the machine on.

tasks.n: Dispose of broken glass
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must pick up three pieces of broken glass lying on the dining-room floor and put all of them into the trash can standing in the corridor. The pieces are low on the floor and the bin is in another room, so the robot has to grasp small items repeatedly and drive between rooms.

tasks.n: Tidy a child's desk
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a child's room must tidy a desk: put folders and paperback books into the bookcase, the pencil and pens into the pencil box, and bring the stapler from the bookcase and the laptop from the bed to the desk, with the laptop closed. Items are scattered over desk, chair, bookcase and bed, making a long multi-object chore.

tasks.n: Scrub rust off garden tools
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator on a garden driveway must scrub all the rust off a trowel and a scraper using steel wool kept in a toolbox, then put both tools into the toolbox and close it. Rust only disappears under sustained scrubbing contact, and the toolbox must be opened first and shut at the end, so the steps are ordered.

tasks.n: Sweep mud off a patio
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must sweep every bit of mud off the garden floor using a broom that lies on the ground. Coverage is what counts, so the robot has to travel across the whole patio while keeping the broom in contact with the floor until nothing is left.

tasks.n: Scrub dust off a trumpet
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must scrub every bit of dust off a dusty cornet, a type of trumpet, lying on the desk, using a scrub brush. The dust only comes off through sustained brush contact over the whole instrument, so the robot needs careful, repeated strokes.

tasks.n: Gather branches into a recycling bin
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garden must pick up four fallen branches lying on the ground and put all of them into the recycling bin, which has to stay standing on the ground. The branches are spread widely across the garden, so the robot must drive repeatedly between them and the bin.

tasks.n: Clear plates and pizza after a meal
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must clear a breakfast table in the kitchen by putting two pizzas, each still on its own plate, into the same refrigerator and two bowls into the sink, leaving every refrigerator closed. The pizzas must stay on their plates through the move, and the fridge door has to be opened and shut again.

tasks.n: Pack leftovers into the fridge
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must clear leftovers from the kitchen breakfast table: put a half chicken and half an apple pie into empty tupperwares from the counter, then put both containers into the refrigerator and shut it. The food must be packed before the nested placement into the fridge, so the steps are ordered.
st: half chicken and half apple pie

tasks.n: Collect soda cans into a bucket
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must gather six soda cans, three lying on the bed and three on the floor, into a bucket standing on the bedroom floor. The cans sit on different surfaces around the room, so the robot has to repeat a pick-and-drop routine at several locations.

tasks.n: Gather toys into one bookcase
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a child's room must collect seven toys, namely two dice and a board game from the bed, two teddy bears from the floor, and a train set and another board game from the desk, and put all of them into the same bookcase. The toys differ in size and are spread over three surfaces, making a long multi-object tidy-up.

tasks.n: Put fruit scraps in the trash
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator starting in the living room must go to the kitchen and put a half banana and a half pomegranate from the countertop into the trash can on the kitchen floor. It is a short task with only two objects, but the robot first has to drive into the right room and then reach from the counter down to a floor bin.

tasks.n: Cook a brisket
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take a raw brisket out of the refrigerator, cook it with a suitable heat source, and put it on a chopping board, while the frying pan ends up back on the countertop. The robot has to choose and switch on an appliance and handle doors, so it is a planning-heavy chain of dependent steps.

tasks.n: Bake a frozen pie
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take a frozen apple pie from the refrigerator, bake it in the oven and place the cooked pie on a tray on the countertop. The refrigerator and oven both have doors, the oven must be switched on and given time to cook, and the pie has to travel between three separate spots.

tasks.n: Cook bacon on the stove
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take a tray of six bacon slices from the refrigerator, move the slices into a frying pan on the stove, switch the stove on and cook all of them, leaving the refrigerator closed. Handling many individual slices and keeping the stove, pan and fridge in the right state make it a long, ordered chore.

tasks.n: Cook broccolini with garlic
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must put three broccolini and two garlic cloves from a plate into a frying pan, place the pan on the stove, switch the stove on and cook the food. The order matters because the pan must be loaded before it goes onto the heat, and several small items must all end up in the pan.

tasks.n: Roast halved brussels sprouts
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take four brussels sprouts from a tupperware in the refrigerator, halve each on a chopping board with a carving knife, roast all the halves in the oven, and close the oven and refrigerator. It combines knife work, appliance doors, switching on the oven and a long ordered chain of steps.

tasks.n: Cook diced cabbage with chili
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must fetch a head of cabbage and a chili from the refrigerator, dice both on a chopping board with a carving knife, and cook the diced pieces in a frying pan on the stove. The dicing yields simulated particles that must all be gathered into the pan, so the task mixes cutting, particle handling and appliance use in a long chain.

tasks.n: Microwave two hot dogs
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take two hot dogs from the refrigerator, put them in the microwave, close it and switch it on to cook them. The refrigerator and microwave both have doors and stand apart from each other, so the robot must open, load, close and start in the correct order.

tasks.n: Dispose of batteries across rooms
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must gather three batteries, two from a desk in the private office and one from a cabinet in the copy room, and put them all into the wastebasket on the copy-room floor, leaving it standing. The items are small and spread over two rooms, so the robot must drive between them.

tasks.n: Move water glasses to a bedroom bin
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must move four water glasses from a bathroom sink into the trash can standing on the bedroom floor. The glasses and the bin are in different rooms, so the robot has to carry a repeated set of items across the house.

tasks.n: Pack fruit into tupperwares for the fridge
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must fetch two tupperwares from a closed cabinet, put one apple and one strawberry into each, place both containers in the refrigerator and close it. The fruit starts in a bowl and on a tray, and the even split between containers plus two doors make the sequence long and ordered.

tasks.n: Freeze pies in tupperwares
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take two apple pies from plates on the countertop, put each into its own tupperware fetched from a cabinet, place both containers in the refrigerator, close it, and wait until the pies are frozen. The cabinet and fridge doors, the packing, and the waiting make it a long ordered chain.

tasks.n: Organize a bedroom desk for work
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must tidy a work desk: the keyboard, mouse, folder, notebook and pen are laid out on and around the desk, the monitor and computer stay where they are, and the swivel chair is pushed up beside the desk. The start is awkward because the keyboard sits on the notebook and the pen lies on the folder on the chair, so items must be freed and restacked in the right order.

tasks.n: Halve a hard-boiled egg
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take a hard-boiled egg out of the refrigerator, cut it in half with a carving knife, put both halves on a plate and finally drop the knife into the sink. The sequence chains opening an appliance, using a sharp tool on food and tidying up afterwards, and a cut only happens when the blade actually touches the egg.

tasks.n: Hang a poster on a wall nail
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a house must pick up a poster lying on the kitchen countertop and hang it on one of the wall nails in the kitchen. The poster only latches on when its attachment point is brought into close alignment with a nail, so the main difficulty is careful positioning at the wall.

tasks.n: Hide Easter eggs beside a tree
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garden must take three Easter eggs out of a wicker basket on the lawn and lay them on the grass next to one tree, the same tree for all three. The trees can be far apart, so the robot has to drive a long way outdoors and stay consistent about its choice of tree while moving the eggs one after another.

tasks.n: Install a fax machine on a carrel
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a shared office must lift a switched-off fax machine from the floor, set it on top of one of the cubicle desks and switch it on. Besides carrying the machine across the office, the robot has to find and press its toggle button, which only registers after a sustained touch by a finger.

tasks.n: Install a modem beside the television
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must pick up a switched-off modem from the coffee table, turn it on and place it next to the television on the cabinet that carries the set. The room has two cabinets, so the robot has to work out which one holds the television, and the modem only switches on when its toggle button is touched by a finger.

tasks.n: Place and switch on a scanner
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a private office must stand a switched-off scanner next to the laptop on the table and turn the scanner on. It is a short task, but it combines positioning one object relative to another with finding and pressing a toggle button.

tasks.n: Mount a smoke detector on a wall nail
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must take a fire alarm lying on a table and attach it to the wall nail in the same room. The table and the nail are several metres apart, so the robot has to drive across the room, and the alarm only latches when its attachment point is lined up closely with the nail.

tasks.n: Lay four tiles on the bathroom floor
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must carry four tiles from the corridor floor to the bathroom floor and lay them down so that every tile sits next to at least one other tile. The tiles have to be moved between rooms one after another and then placed close together, which makes it a long carrying job with a layout condition.

tasks.n: Load a container and racket into a car
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must load a car in the garage: it puts a digital camera into a container in the living room, then brings the container and a tennis racket to the car and places both inside. The car starts closed and the trip runs between rooms, so the task nests one object inside another, opens an articulated door and needs a plan in the right order.

tasks.n: Attach a door to a cabinet base
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room finds a cabinet base and a cabinet door lying on the floor and must attach the door to the base. The two parts fit together only when their attachment points are brought close to a compatible match, so this is a small assembly job that depends on careful alignment.

tasks.n: Fill two baby-shower gift bags
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must make two gift bags: it moves two sacks from the breakfast table to the coffee table and puts one toy die and one wafer into each sack. The dice stand on a cabinet and the wafers are inside the closed cabinet, so the robot must open it, and each sack has to end up with exactly one of each item.

tasks.n: Cook popcorn in a microwave
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must put a bag of popcorn kernels into the microwave and heat it until the popcorn has popped inside the bag. The job needs a sequence of opening the microwave door, loading the bag, closing the door, switching the microwave on and waiting, so the robot has to operate an appliance and then let it run.

tasks.n: Top and bake a pizza
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must top a pizza dough with cheese, pepperoni, halved mushrooms and diced onion, then bake it in the oven until it becomes a pizza on its cookie sheet. The ingredients start in the refrigerator, the mushrooms and onion must be cut with a knife, and the grated cheese has to be poured on as loose particles, making it a long recipe chain.

tasks.n: Arrange roses in a vase centerpiece
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must put three roses into a vase that sits on a cabinet and then stand the vase on the coffee table as a centerpiece. The cabinet and the coffee table are a few metres apart, so after filling the vase the robot must carry it across the room and set it down upright.

tasks.n: Move two storage containers to the garage
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must transport two storage containers from the living-room floor to the garage, setting one on the garage floor and stacking the other on top of it, in either order. The route crosses rooms and ends in a stack of two containers, so both a long drive and a stable stack matter.

tasks.n: Pack art supplies into a carryall
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must put the art supplies lying on the desk, a glue stick, an eraser, a paintbrush and a marker, into a carryall standing on the floor, and then lift the carryall onto the desk. Four small items go into one bag, and the filled bag itself must then be raised from the floor to the desk.
st: glue stick, eraser, paintbrush and marker

tasks.n: Pack school things into a carryall
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must gather five school items, a pencil, a book and a folder from the bed and a pen and a calculator from the floor, into a carryall, then place the carryall on the bed. The items are spread around the room, so the robot must drive between bed and floor and handle very different objects.
st: pencil, book, folder, pen and calculator

tasks.n: Pack five tools into a toolbox
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a utility room must put a drill, pliers, a flashlight, an allen wrench and a screwdriver into a toolbox on a table, keep it on the table, and close its lid at the end. The open, insert, close order matters, since the toolbox must be opened first and finish shut with all five tools inside.
st: drill, pliers, flashlight, allen wrench and screwdriver

tasks.n: Pack three burgers for delivery
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must put each of three wrapped hamburgers from a tray into its own sack and then stand all three sacks on top of a storage container. Every burger needs a separate sack, and the finished sacks must end up resting on the container rather than inside it.

tasks.n: Put six toys in a toy box
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a child's room must pick up six toys, three board games, two jigsaw puzzles and a tennis ball, from the bed and the table and put them all inside the toy box. The toys are scattered over two places and differ in kind, so the job is a repetitive tidy-up that requires driving between the bed and the table.

tasks.n: Carry soda cans to the kitchen trash can
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must take three soda cans from the living room and put them inside the trash can in the kitchen. The cans and the bin are in different rooms, so the robot must grasp each can, drive through the house and drop it into the bin, repeating the trip for all three.

tasks.n: Brush the dust off two shoes
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must pick up a scrub brush, brush all the dust off two dusty shoes, put the brush back on its stand and set the shoes next to each other and next to the same footstool. Removing every speck takes sustained brush contact, and the task chains tool use, cleaning and final tidy placement in order.

tasks.n: Pack a lunch box from the kitchen
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must pack apple halves, a club sandwich, a cookie and a bottle of tea into a packing box, taking the tea from the refrigerator and leaving the refrigerator closed. The robot must open the door, fetch the bottle, close it again, and gather five items from two places into one box.
st: apple halves, sandwich, cookie and tea bottle

tasks.n: Pack a pruning kit in a toolbox
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garage must put a pruner and a pair of shears from the floor into a toolbox, then close the toolbox lid while leaving the box on the floor. It is a compact open, insert, close sequence in which the toolbox has to end shut around both garden tools.

tasks.n: Store Halloween decorations in cabinets
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must put two pumpkins and three candles away inside the living-room cabinets, close every cabinet, and leave a cauldron beside a living-room table. Several cabinets must be opened and then left shut, so the task is a long sequence of opening, storing and closing across the room.

tasks.n: Put eight toy figures in toy boxes
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must tidy eight toy figures lying on the floor, four in the living room and four in the dining room, into two toy boxes, either box being acceptable. One box stands on the living-room floor and the other on the dining-room table, so the robot has to drive between rooms and manage many repeated pick-and-place steps.

tasks.n: Move dirty dishes to the kitchen sink
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must carry two bowls and two plates from a booth in the dining room to the sink in the kitchen, where the dirt on them does not matter. The sink is far from the booth, so the main difficulty is the long drive and the repeated placing of four dishes into the basin.

tasks.n: Put eight plates in one cabinet
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must move eight clean plates from two countertops into a single kitchen cabinet and leave every cabinet closed. Opening the cabinet, loading all eight plates and shutting it again are all required, and the plates start in two separate spots a few metres apart.

tasks.n: Hang two pairs of shoes on a rack
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must put both pairs of shoes onto the hall tree in a corridor. The shoes lie several metres from the rack along the corridor, so the robot has to drive back and forth and place four shoes on the rack, with the shoes of each pair ending up next to each other.

tasks.n: Decorate the house for Christmas
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must dress a house for Christmas, starting from a tree, three gift boxes and a wicker basket holding a wreath, candy canes and candles in the living room. Gift boxes go by the tree, candles on a dining-room table, one candy cane on a table, and the wreath and two canes on a sofa, so items travel to several places in different rooms.

tasks.n: Reshelve library books in bookcases
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must pick up three books lying on a table and put each one inside a bookcase, where different books may go into different bookcases. The bookcases are some distance from the table, so the robot repeatedly drives, grasps a book and slots it into a shelf.

tasks.n: Rearrange a bedroom
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must move a tissue dispenser from an armchair onto one of the stands and put the two pillows lying on the floor onto the two beds, one on each. The items sit far apart around the room and each bed must receive exactly one pillow, so the plan needs a little bookkeeping.

tasks.n: Store three appliances in a cabinet
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must put a toaster, a food processor and a French press from the countertop away into one kitchen cabinet, and then close that cabinet. The task is an open, insert, close sequence that squeezes three different appliances through a single cabinet door.
st: toaster, food processor and french press

tasks.n: Scrub the bathroom floor clean
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must pick up a scrub brush and scrub a bathroom floor covered in dirt until none remains. The dirt is made of many small particles and counts as gone only after the brush has swept over it, so the robot needs sustained, broad contact over the whole floor rather than a quick pass.

tasks.n: Set up a kitchen coffee station
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must arrange a coffee station around the coffee maker on the countertop: a bottle of coffee comes from a shelf to stand beside it, a paper filter goes on top, a cup goes on a saucer next to the machine, and an electric kettle stands beside it too. Several objects must be positioned relative to one another, some stacked and some alongside.
st: bottle of coffee and electric kettle

tasks.n: Set mousetraps on the bathroom floor
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bathroom must take four mousetraps lying on the bathroom cabinet and put them on the floor, with exactly two of them under or beside one of the sinks. The count condition forces the robot to choose a split, two near a sink and two elsewhere, while it carries the traps from the cabinet down to the floor.

tasks.n: Light a fire in the fireplace
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must put a newspaper inside the fireplace with two pieces of firewood on top, light the newspaper and firewood with a cigar lighter, and then switch the lighter off again. The task carries a safety rule, since leaving the lighter on counts against the run, so the robot must build the stack in order, ignite it and tidy up safely.

tasks.n: Set the breakfast table for two
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must lay a dining-room breakfast table for two: two plates come from a kitchen cabinet, two cupcakes from the refrigerator, and forks and knives from the kitchen sink end up beside each plate. Plates must go down first so the cupcakes and cutlery have somewhere to go, and two closed stores must be opened along the way, so the order of steps matters.

tasks.n: Set up a cocktail party bar
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must set up a bar, moving a wine bottle, three soda cans, two wine glasses, a corkscrew, an ice bucket and six ice cubes from a cabinet onto the bar countertop in prescribed positions relative to each other. About fourteen objects are tied together by next-to requirements anchored on the wine bottle, so the layout is the hard part.

tasks.n: Dice five vegetables from the fridge
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take two bell peppers, two beets and a zucchini out of the refrigerator, dice every one of them on the chopping boards with a paring knife, and leave the refrigerator closed. It couples door handling, tool use with a knife and repeated cutting, and none of the vegetables may be left whole.

tasks.n: Restack books in the bookcase by kind
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must regroup seven books inside a bookcase so that the three comic books are stacked together, one notebook lies on the other, and one hardback lies on the other. Books of different kinds start lying on one another, so the robot must tell the kinds apart and unstack before restacking.

tasks.n: Sort bottles, cans and paper
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must sort recycling scattered on the countertop and floor into three buckets: both wine bottles in one, both soda cans in another, and the newspaper and magazine in the third, with no mixing. The items sit far from the buckets, so the robot drives around and relies on recognizing each object's category.

tasks.n: Sort household items into the bathroom
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must unpack two baskets from the bedroom floor and place their contents in the bathroom: detergent under the sink, napkins on the shelf, the soap dispenser on the sink, the toothbrush in the cup and the toothpaste beside it. Each item has its own destination relative to bathroom fixtures, so the robot must carry things between rooms and keep track of where each belongs.

tasks.n: Sort vegetables into three bowls
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must empty two baskets of vegetables into three mixing bowls on the countertop, grouping bok choy with onions, leeks with broccoli, and sweet corn alone. Telling similar-looking produce apart decides which bowl each item goes into, and the baskets stand on the floor some distance from the countertop.

tasks.n: Spray two potted plants for bugs
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garden must use an insectifuge atomizer to spray two potted plants until each of them is covered with the liquid. It is a short tool-use task in which the robot has to aim a handheld sprayer so that the spray reaches both plants.

tasks.n: Spray pesticide on two fruit trees
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garden must pick up a pesticide atomizer lying on the ground and spray pesticide onto both fruit trees until each of them is covered. The two trees stand far apart, so the robot has to drive a long way outdoors and aim the sprayer at each tree in turn.

tasks.n: Gather and stack logs in a driveway
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a garden must collect six logs spread out along a driveway and pile them up so that every log touches at least one other log. The logs lie far apart, so most of the effort goes into long driving and repeated carrying before the pile can be built.

tasks.n: Store three batteries in a cabinet
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must gather three batteries, two from the living-room coffee table and one from the kitchen countertop, and put all three inside the same one of the two living-room cabinets. The cabinet starts closed and the batteries start in different rooms, so the robot must drive between rooms, open a door and commit to a single cabinet.

tasks.n: Put a honey jar in the entryway cabinet
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator that starts in the living room must fetch a jar of honey from the kitchen countertop and put it inside the cabinet in the entryway. The cabinet starts closed, so the robot has to open it, and the jar must travel from one room to another before it can be placed.

tasks.n: Store mangos and pomegranates in a refrigerator
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must move two mangos and two pomegranates from a wicker basket on the floor into one of the two kitchen refrigerators, all four into the same one. The refrigerator door has to be opened, and the basket sits well away from the refrigerators, so the robot has to drive and repeat the transfer.

tasks.n: Store eight groceries in kitchen cabinets
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must put eight pantry items, two each of oatmeal, chips, olive oil and sugar, from the countertop into kitchen cabinets, any cabinet being acceptable. The cabinets start closed and sit several metres from the counter, so the task is a long run of opening doors, carrying and placing across the kitchen.
st: oatmeal, chips, olive oil and sugar

tasks.n: Sweep sand and dust from the garage
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must sweep a garage floor covered with sand and dust, using a broom, until none remains. Both count as removed only through sustained broom contact, and the whole floor has to be covered, so the robot must plan a systematic sweeping route with a hand tool.
st: sand and dust on garage floor

tasks.n: Thaw chicken and bread with appliances
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a kitchen must take a frozen chicken breast and a frozen slice of bread, each on a plate, out of the refrigerator, put the chicken in the microwave and switch it on, set the bread on the countertop and close the refrigerator, so that neither food is still frozen. It chains opening and closing two appliances in a strict order.

tasks.n: Tidy a bathroom
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must tidy a bathroom by putting a bar of soap on its dish, the tissue dispenser on the sink, a roll of toilet tissue on the toilet and a cork into the wastebasket. Four small items each have their own destination, spread several metres apart between sink, toilet and floor, so the robot drives around and makes four different placements.

tasks.n: Tidy a bedroom
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a bedroom must put one sandal next to the bed and the second sandal next to the first, then move a book from the bed onto a table. Only three objects are involved, but they sit a few metres apart and the sandals have to finish side by side next to the bed.

tasks.n: Tidy a living room
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must tidy a living room by moving a potted plant and a newspaper from the floor onto the coffee table, a hardback book from the coffee table into a bookcase, and a notebook from the coffee table onto the desk. Four objects have different destinations scattered across the room, so the robot has to plan its trips and keep the destinations straight.

tasks.n: Switch on a radio
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a living room must switch on a radio receiver standing on a table. The task boils down to a single press, but the robot has to bring a finger to the toggle button and keep touching it long enough for the switch to flip.

tasks.n: Turn off every light before sleep
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must switch off all the lights in a house before bed: three wall switches in the kitchen, utility room and dining room, and two table lamps in the living room and the utility room, all of which start on. Five separate switches are spread over four rooms, so the task is mostly a long tour of the house with a press at each stop.

tasks.n: Unload bags from a car
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must unload a car in the garage by taking a briefcase and a satchel out and putting them next to the sofa in the living room. The car starts closed, so the robot must open it before it can reach the bags, and then carry both items into another room.

tasks.n: Vacuum dust off a bedroom floor
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator must remove every bit of dust from a bedroom floor using the vacuum cleaner standing on it. The dust consists of many small particles that must all be picked up, so the robot has to operate and steer a cleaning tool over the whole floor.

tasks.n: Wash two baseball caps in a washer
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a utility room must get two dirty baseball caps from the countertop completely clean, and the only means of cleaning in the scene is the washer. The robot has to realize this, then open the washer, load both caps, close it and switch it on.

tasks.n: Wash four dog toys in a washing machine
tasks.t: An R1Pro mobile manipulator in a utility room must clean four dog toys, two teddy bears, a tennis ball and a softball, which are stored in a cabinet and are dirty, dusty or covered in debris. The robot must open the cabinet, move all four toys into the washing machine, close it and switch it on.

tasks.n: Put apple and yogurt in bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put an apple and a yogurt cup into a wooden bowl on a cluttered desk and release them so both rest inside. Many everyday items such as a mug, keyboard, phone and pitcher surround the targets, so the arm must pick the right objects and carry out two placements in turn.

tasks.n: Place a banana in a bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up a banana from a table and put it into a bowl, then let go. The scene holds only the banana and the bowl, so the challenge is a clean grasp of a long, curved fruit and a reliable release inside the container.

tasks.n: Place banana, then cube, in bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put a banana and then a Rubik's cube into a bowl on a table, with the banana going in first. The order of the first placements is part of the goal, so the arm has to sequence two pick-and-place moves correctly instead of just getting both objects in.

tasks.n: Add exactly one banana to bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper faces a grey bin and a set of bananas on a table and must put exactly one more banana into the bin. Adding two would count as a failure, so the arm has to stop after a single clean placement rather than keep loading the bin.

tasks.n: Top up bin to three bananas
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must make sure a grey bin ends up holding three bananas, adding from the bananas lying on the table. The goal is an exact count rather than a named object, so the arm has to work out how many more are needed and add just that many.

tasks.n: Take bananas out of the bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take both bananas out of a grey bin and leave them outside it on the table. This reverses the usual put-in-container direction, so the arm has to reach into a confined bin, grasp each curved fruit, and release it clear of the container.

tasks.n: Put red BBQ bottles in bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick the red barbecue sauce bottles out of a table of mixed food and household items and drop both into a grey bin. Mustard, ranch dressing and a cleaning-product bottle look similar, so the arm must recognise the right bottles by colour and label before placing each one.

tasks.n: Stack four blocks into a tower
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must stack four coloured blocks into one tower on a table, in whatever order it likes. Each block has to sit on the one below and the tower must stay standing, so it is a chain of dependent placements in which an early misalignment can topple the rest.

tasks.n: Stack blocks in a colour order
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must stack four coloured blocks into a tower in a prescribed colour order from bottom to top: red, blue, green, then yellow. The arm has to identify each block by colour and build the tower level by level, with every placement depending on the accuracy of the one before.

tasks.n: Sort coloured blocks into bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must sort the plain coloured blocks into a grey bin, leaving other items behind. Three Rubik's cubes, a birdhouse and lizard figurines also sit on the table, so the arm has to tell the simple blocks apart from similar cubes and decoys before picking each one.

tasks.n: Put butter box on raisin box
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up a butter box and place it on top of a raisin box on a table. With only two boxes in the scene, the difficulty lies in a stable placement, so the butter box has to come to rest on the raisin box rather than slide off.

tasks.n: Bin the plastic bottles from clutter
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put all the plastic bottles and jugs from a table crowded with fruit, vegetables and kitchen items into a blue bin. The containers differ in type and sit among many look-alike decoys such as lemons and pumpkins, so the arm must recognise the plastic ones before placing each.

tasks.n: Bin both pumpkins from clutter
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put both pumpkins, one large and one small, into a blue bin from a table crowded with other fruit, vegetables and kitchen items. Lemons, limes, oranges and an onion are mixed in as decoys, so the arm must pick out the pumpkins and handle objects of different sizes.

tasks.n: Sort sauce bottles into bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must gather the sauce condiment bottles from a table of assorted food and household items and put them into a grey bin. A cleaning-product bottle of similar shape acts as a decoy, so the arm must recognise which bottles are sauces rather than grab any bottle.

tasks.n: Clear measuring tools off a plate
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take two measuring utensils off a clay plate and set them down on the table outside the plate. The scene is crowded with similar spoons, ladles and servers, so the arm must pick out the right two items and release them clear of the plate.

tasks.n: Bin all cubes and blocks
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put every cube and block on a table into a grey bin, covering three Rubik's cubes and four plain coloured blocks. A birdhouse and lizard figurines are also present as decoys, so the arm needs a long run of repeated pick-and-place moves while recognising which objects count.

tasks.n: Pack two cans into a bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pack the canned foods, a tomato soup can and a tuna can, into a bin, leaving other food packages on the table. The arm must tell the cans from the nearby boxes and a mustard bottle, then place both cans inside the container.

tasks.n: Pack three cans into a bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pack the canned foods, a Spam can, a tomato soup can and a tuna can, into a bin, while a pudding cup, cracker box, mustard bottle and sugar box stay out. The arm must tell cans from other packages and place all three inside the container.

tasks.n: Put green fruit on plate
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put all the green fruit, the two limes, onto a clay plate on a crowded table. Lemons, oranges and other fruit of similar shape are mixed in, so the arm has to decide which pieces count as green by colour before picking and placing each one.

tasks.n: Put exactly three fruits on plate
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put three pieces of fruit on a clay plate, choosing freely among lemons, limes, oranges and a pomegranate on a crowded table. The count is exact, so the arm has to stop after three and not overfill the plate.

tasks.n: Lift keyboard out of bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take a keyboard out of a grey bin, where it sits tilted, and lay it on the table. The keyboard is a large, flat object leaning inside a container, so the arm has to find a grasp that lifts it clear of the walls while other desk items are on the table.

tasks.n: Bin the larger of two boxes
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must place the larger of two similar food boxes, a raisin box and a butter box, into a grey bin. The instruction names only a size, not a colour or label, so the arm must compare the two boxes visually before choosing which one to pick up.

tasks.n: Put whiteboard marker in mug
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up a whiteboard marker from a cluttered desk and drop it into a ceramic mug. The marker is thin and the mug opening narrow, with many other desk items around, so the arm needs a careful grasp and an accurate release over the mug.

tasks.n: Put mustard on raisin box
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up a mustard bottle and set it on top of a raisin box on a table. A bottle resting on a flat box is a precarious stack, so the arm has to place it carefully enough that it stays put instead of tipping off.

tasks.n: Put mustard in the left bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put a mustard bottle into the left one of two identical grey bins on a table. Because the bins look the same, the arm must reason about which side is meant and choose the correct container rather than just any bin.

tasks.n: Put mustard in the right bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put a mustard bottle into the right one of two identical grey bins on a table. Because the bins look the same, the arm must reason about which side is meant and choose the correct container rather than just any bin.

tasks.n: Pick up the eyeglasses
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up a pair of eyeglasses from a desk cluttered with a mug, keyboard, phone, remote and other everyday items, and lift them off the surface. Eyeglasses are thin and light, so the arm must find a workable grasp while neighbouring objects get in the way.

tasks.n: Pick up the orange measuring cup
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up and lift the orange measuring cup from a table crowded with colourful kitchen utensils. Other measuring and serving tools in different colours, including a blue scoop, are mixed in, so the arm must find the object from its colour description before grasping it.

tasks.n: Pick up the large blue pitcher
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up the large blue pitcher from a table where it stands near a jerrican and a pail, and lift it clear of the surface. The nearby containers are similar plastic items, so the arm must identify the right one and find a good grasp on a big object.

tasks.n: Small bottles into the square pail
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put all the small white plastic bottles into a square pail, ignoring the larger utility jugs and a round pail also on the table. The arm must judge size and shape to separate bottles from jugs and pick the right container, then repeat the placement for each bottle.

tasks.n: Put two mugs on the wire shelf
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must place exactly two of three mugs onto a wire shelving unit, with cutlery and a small plate also on the table. The count is exact, so the arm should stop after two, and it has to set the mugs down stably on the open wire surface.

tasks.n: Recycle cartons into grey bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put the recyclable cartons, a milk carton and an orange juice carton, into a grey container on a table that also holds a soup can, bottles, a mug and a phone. The arm must pick out the two cartons from similar packaged goods and place both.

tasks.n: Recycle cartons into vertical crate
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put the recyclable cartons, a milk carton and an orange juice carton, into an upright crate on a table that also holds a soup can, bottles, a mug and a phone. The arm must pick out the two cartons from similar packaged goods and place both in the crate.

tasks.n: Put red dishware in bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put the red dishware, a red mug and a red bowl, into a grey bin, while a banana and a Rubik's cube also lie on the table. The arm must work out from colour and type which items are the red dishes and then perform two separate placements.

tasks.n: Set the red mug upright
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must find the red mug among several other mugs and kitchen tools and put it upright so that its opening faces up. The arm has to grasp a mug that is not upright, turn it over, and set it down stably, while picking the right red mug out of similar ones.

tasks.n: Put cube and banana in bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put both a Rubik's cube and a banana into a bowl on a table, in either order, and let go of them. The two objects differ in shape, one blocky and one long and curved, so the arm needs a different grasp for each.

tasks.n: Place cube behind the bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must move a Rubik's cube so that it ends up behind a bowl on the table, as seen from the robot's own side. The goal is a spatial relation rather than a container, so the arm must understand which direction counts as behind and set the cube down on the table there.

tasks.n: Place cube in front of bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must move a Rubik's cube so that it ends up in front of a bowl on the table, as seen from the robot's own side. The goal is a spatial relation rather than a container, so the arm must understand which direction counts as in front and set the cube down at that spot.

tasks.n: Place cube left of the bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must move a Rubik's cube so that it ends up to the left of a bowl on a table, as seen from the robot's own side, with a banana also lying nearby. The goal is a spatial relation rather than a container, so the arm must interpret which side counts as left and set the cube down there.

tasks.n: Place cube right of the bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must move a Rubik's cube so that it ends up to the right of a bowl on a table, as seen from the robot's own side, with a banana, a mug and a grey bin also in the scene. The goal is a spatial relation rather than a container, so the arm must interpret which side counts as right and set the cube down there.

tasks.n: Place cube, then banana, in bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put a Rubik's cube and then a banana into a bowl on a table, with the cube going in first. The order of the placements is part of the goal, so the arm has to sequence two pick-and-place moves correctly and use a different grasp for the blocky cube and the curved fruit.

tasks.n: Sort Rubik's cubes into bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must sort all three Rubik's cubes on a table into a grey bin. Four plain coloured blocks of similar size, a birdhouse and lizard figurines sit among them as decoys, so the arm must tell the Rubik's cubes from the simple blocks before picking and placing each one.

tasks.n: Move the spoon from bowl to mug
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take the metal spoon that rests in a wooden bowl and put it into a ceramic mug on a cluttered desk. The spoon is picked out of one container and dropped into another among many desk items, so the arm needs a careful grasp of a thin utensil and an accurate release over the mug.

tasks.n: Stack yellow block on red
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up the yellow block and set it on top of the red block, leaving the red block where it is. Blue and green blocks, three Rubik's cubes and several figurines crowd the table, so the arm must pick the two correct blocks by colour and place the yellow one squarely.

tasks.n: Stack three Rubik's cubes
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must stack three Rubik's cubes into one tower on a table, in any order. Each cube has to rest squarely on the one below, so the arm makes a chain of dependent placements in which a small misalignment early on can topple the whole stack.

tasks.n: Take white spoon out of red bowl
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take a white measuring spoon out of a red bowl and put it on the table. Several mugs and a cordless drill are also around, including white mugs that look similar, so the arm must pick out the right utensil and reach into the bowl to lift it clear.

tasks.n: Take the mugs off the shelf
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take both mugs off a small shelving rack and set them on the table. The mugs sit on a rack with a serving bowl and a jug nearby, so the arm must reach onto the shelf, grasp each mug without disturbing the rack, and carry it clear before releasing.

tasks.n: Take the spatula off the shelf
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take a spatula off a wire shelving unit and put it on the table. Mugs, forks and a small plate are nearby, so the arm has to pick out the right utensil from among similar kitchenware and lift it off the open wire shelf without knocking other things over.

tasks.n: Throw away the snacks
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper is asked to put away the snacks in the bin, which here means moving an apple and a yogurt cup from a cluttered desk into a plastic pail. The instruction never names the items, so the arm must work out which objects count as snacks among many desk items and place both.

tasks.n: Take cordless drill out of bin
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick out the cordless drill from among several tools stored in three bins and put it on the table. Clamps and hammers of different colours are mixed in, so the arm must recognise the drill, reach into the correct bin, and lift it clear without tangling with the other tools.

tasks.n: Unstack a Rubik's cube tower
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must take apart a tower of three Rubik's cubes and leave each cube separately on the table. The cubes must be lifted off one after another from the top, among a bowl, a mug, a bottle and a banana, so the arm must avoid knocking the tower or its neighbours before every cube is freed.

tasks.n: Put fork and spoon in mug
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must put a fork and a spoon into a ceramic mug on a table crowded with food, plates and bottles. Both utensils are thin and must be dropped into a narrow opening, so the arm needs to pick them out of the clutter and release each accurately over the mug.

tasks.n: Move white mug to table centre
tasks.t: A single Franka arm with a two-finger Robotiq gripper must pick up the white mug and set it down in the centre of the table, among a bowl, a banana, cartons, a can, a phone and a Rubik's cube. The target is a place on the table rather than a container, so the arm must judge the table's middle and place the mug there accurately.

tasks.n: Move vegetables from sink to board
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must take the vegetables out of the sink and set them on the cutting board. It is a multi-object pick-and-place in a kitchen scene, and every vegetable has to end up on the board, not just the first one.

tasks.n: Thaw a squash in the microwave
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must put a squash from the counter into the microwave and switch the microwave on. The door starts closed and the start only registers once it is shut again, so the arm must open the door, load the squash, close the door and then press start, in that order.

tasks.n: Soak pan and sponge in sink
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must move a pan and a sponge into the sink and then turn the water on. Two objects have to be relocated before the faucet handle is turned, so the task chains transport with a final turning motion on the tap.

tasks.n: Prepare a cup of coffee
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must fetch a mug from an open cabinet, put it under the coffee machine's dispenser and then press the start button. It chains a pick-and-place with a button press, so the mug has to be positioned correctly before the machine is started.

tasks.n: Restock cans into the cabinet
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must move the cans from the counter into a cabinet, each onto its designated side. The right side has to be worked out from the image, since each can belongs with the matching item and not next to the item of a different kind, so the task mixes pick-and-place with category-based sorting.

tasks.n: Shut both cabinet doors
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must push closed the two doors of a cabinet that start open. Both hinged panels have to end up shut, so the arm must reach each door in turn and swing it all the way to the frame rather than leaving one ajar.

tasks.n: Close the open left drawer
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, standing in a simulated kitchen, must push the left drawer of a cabinet shut. That drawer is the only one left open, so the task is a short pushing motion along the drawer's sliding axis, with the side named in the instruction deciding which drawer to move.

tasks.n: Close the microwave door
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must shut the door of a microwave oven in a simulated kitchen. The door starts open on its hinge and has to end up essentially closed, so the arm needs to reach around the appliance and push the panel fully into its frame.

tasks.n: Press the coffee machine button
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must press the button on a coffee machine so that it serves coffee. The goal is a single press, but the button sits on the appliance, so the arm has to find it and press it cleanly.

tasks.n: Move mug from dispenser to counter
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must lift a mug that sits under a coffee machine's dispenser and set it down on the counter. The mug starts tucked beneath the machine, so the grasp and the path out are constrained by the appliance above it.

tasks.n: Place mug under coffee dispenser
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must pick a mug up from the kitchen counter and put it down under the dispenser of a coffee machine. The mug has to end up beneath the spout, so the placement needs careful alignment and the arm must avoid the appliance above.

tasks.n: Open both cabinet doors
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must swing open the two doors of a closed cabinet. Both hinged panels have to end up almost fully open, so the arm must grip or hook each door in turn and pull it wide without losing contact too early.

tasks.n: Pull open the right drawer
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must pull the right-hand drawer of a cabinet nearly all the way out. The arm has to grip the handle and drag along the drawer's sliding axis, and it must pick the correct drawer by side.

tasks.n: Open a cabinet door
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must open the door of a closed kitchen cabinet in simulation, swinging it out to a wide angle. The hinged panel only gives way if the arm grips the handle and pulls along the right arc, so the motion is guided by the door's hinge.

tasks.n: Move hot dog from cabinet to counter
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must take a hot dog out of an open cabinet and put it down on the counter. The food item sits inside the cabinet, so the grasp and the path out must clear the frame and the shelf.

tasks.n: Put a cake into the cabinet
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must pick a cake up from the counter and place it inside an open cabinet. Getting it into the enclosed shelf space takes a deliberate approach, since the arm must reach in past the frame without knocking the door or the cake.

tasks.n: Put corn into the microwave
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must pick up an ear of corn from the counter and set it on the plate inside an open microwave. The target is a plate inside the microwave, so the placement needs a careful approach without bumping the door.

tasks.n: Move an apple into the sink
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must pick an apple off the kitchen counter and drop it into the sink basin in simulation. It is a single-object transfer to a nearby fixture, so it mainly tests a clean grasp and a reliable placement into the basin.

tasks.n: Move potato from plate into pan
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must lift a potato off a plate and put it in a pan on the stove. The potato starts on a plate and must go into the pan, so the arm must grasp the potato cleanly and place it inside the pan rather than on the burner.

tasks.n: Move onion from microwave to plate
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must take an onion out of an open microwave and place it on a plate on the counter. The onion starts inside the appliance, so the grasp and the way out are limited by the door and walls, and the plate is the target.

tasks.n: Move tomato from sink to plate
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must lift a tomato out of the sink and set it down on a plate on the counter. The tomato lies in the basin and the plate is the goal, so the arm must grasp from inside the sink and place accurately on the plate.

tasks.n: Move steak from pan to plate
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must take a steak out of a pan on the stove and place it on a plate in a simulated kitchen. The meat sits in a pan, so the arm must grasp it from inside the cookware and carry it over to the plate without dropping it.

tasks.n: Press the microwave stop button
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must press the stop button on a microwave oven in a simulated kitchen. The task is a single press on a control panel, so it mainly tests locating the right button and pressing it firmly enough to register.

tasks.n: Turn off the sink faucet
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must turn the sink faucet handle back to its off position. The handle moves on a hinge, so the arm has to grasp or push it along the correct arc and return it fully to the off setting.

tasks.n: Turn off a stove burner
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must turn the front right burner of the stove off by rotating its knob back to the closed position. Several burners are available, so the arm must pick out the correct knob by position and rotate it back close to the off setting.

tasks.n: Press the microwave start button
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must press the start button on a microwave oven whose door is closed. It is one press, but the button sits on the front panel, so the arm must locate it and press accurately enough to start the appliance.

tasks.n: Turn on the sink faucet
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must switch the kitchen sink faucet on in simulation by moving its handle from the off position past the on threshold. The handle rotates on a single hinge, so the arm has to push or grip it and swing it far enough to count as on.

tasks.n: Turn on a stove burner
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must light the front left burner of the stove by rotating its control knob from off to on. With several knobs on the stove, the arm must find the right one by position and turn it far enough to engage.

tasks.n: Swing the sink spout right
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must swing the sink's spout sideways so that it points to the right. The spout pivots about its base, so the arm has to push or grip it and rotate it through a clear angle, in the correct direction.

tasks.n: Close the open right drawer
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must push the right drawer of a cabinet shut, starting from a drawer that is partly open. It is a short pushing motion along the drawer's sliding axis, and the drawer has to end up essentially closed.

tasks.n: Close the oven door
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must shut an oven door that starts fully open. The hinged door has to swing all the way back into its frame, so the arm must reach the open door and push it through its whole range.

tasks.n: Lower the stand mixer head
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must close a stand mixer by pushing its head down from the fully raised position. The head has to end up almost completely down, so the arm must push on it along its hinge arc.

tasks.n: Open the dishwasher door
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso stands in a home kitchen and must swing a closed dishwasher door open to nearly its full range. Although the goal is a single motion, the door is a hinged mechanism, so the robot must find a good place to stand, get a firm hold on the door and drag it along its arc without slipping off.

tasks.n: Add marshmallow to hot-dog tupperware
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso, in a home kitchen, must pick up a marshmallow and drop it into the tupperware that already holds a hot dog. The challenge is picking out the right container by its contents, then placing a small, light item into it cleanly.

tasks.n: Take ice cube from cabinet to counter
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must pick an ice cube out of an open kitchen cabinet and set it on the countertop. It is a single pick-and-place, but the cube is a small slippery item stored inside a cabinet, so the robot has to position its base so the arm can reach into the confined space and grasp it.

tasks.n: Move egg from sink to plate
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must lift an egg out of the kitchen sink and set it on a plate that sits on the counter. The egg is a rounded, easily dropped item resting in the sink basin, so the robot has to grasp it securely and carry it up and across to the plate rather than to just any spot on the counter.

tasks.n: Stop the microwave
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso stands in a kitchen and must press the stop button on the microwave. It is among the shortest tasks, a single button press, yet the robot still has to place its base within reach, pick the right button on the panel and press it firmly enough to register.

tasks.n: Start the microwave
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso stands in a kitchen and must press the start button on the microwave. It is among the shortest tasks, a single button press, yet the robot still has to place its base within reach, pick the right button on the panel and press it firmly enough to register.

tasks.n: Turn on the sink faucet
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must turn on the faucet of a kitchen sink by moving its handle into the on position. There is no object to carry, only a mechanism with a limited range, so the robot has to find the handle, approach it from a workable angle and push it far enough.

tasks.n: Set the toaster oven timer
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must turn on a toaster oven in a kitchen by twisting its timer knob to a set position. The knob winds itself back after being set, so the setting must still count as on when the motion ends, which makes the timing of the turn matter as well as its size.

tasks.n: Take lemon from fridge to fish plate
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, in a simulated kitchen, must take a lemon wedge out of a closed fridge and put it on a plate of fish on the dining counter. The lemon is hidden inside the fridge and the dining counter is behind the robot, neither visible at the start, so the robot must open the door and drive over.

tasks.n: Set up shrimp, syrup and broccoli
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must put shrimp into a pan on the stove, then take a syrup bottle and broccoli out of a cabinet and put them on the counter by the plate. The cabinet items lie beyond the arm's reach from the start, so the base has to drive in addition to several pick-and-place moves.

tasks.n: Sort drinks into two cabinets
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must sort several drinks, putting the alcoholic ones in one cabinet and the non-alcoholic ones in the other. The robot has to classify each drink from its look, such as liquor and beer versus can and bottled drink, and the second cabinet is far enough away to require driving the base.

tasks.n: Put bread and cheese on board
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must place a piece of bread and a piece of cheese onto the cutting board. It is a short two-object arrangement, so the difficulty is in picking up each item reliably and ending with both resting on the board.

tasks.n: Tidy candle and jar into cabinet
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, in a simulated kitchen, must pick a candle and a jar off the dining table, put them in an open cabinet and then close the cabinet. The cabinet is behind the robot at the start, and the door can only be shut after both objects are inside, so the order of the steps matters.

tasks.n: Set out cereal and bowl
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must open a closed cabinet, take out a cereal box and a bowl, put both on the counter next to the milk and close the cabinet again. The items are hidden until the door opens, and the steps depend on one another, so the robot must work through them in order.

tasks.n: Fetch the smaller measuring cup
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must open the right drawer and put the smaller of two measuring cups on the counter. Both cups are inside the closed drawer, so which one is smaller can only be judged once it is open, and the larger cup must stay off the counter.

tasks.n: Clear food scraps into colander
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must move the food items lying in the sink into a colander. There are several items to relocate, so the robot has to pick each one out of the basin in turn and end with all of them in the colander.

tasks.n: Swap vegetables and dishes in sink
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must take a corn and a carrot out of the sink and then move a bowl and a cup from the counter into the sink for washing. Four pick-and-place moves are needed, and the sink has to be emptied of the vegetables before the dishes go in.

tasks.n: Bring egg and butter to mixing bowl
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, in a simulated kitchen, must take an egg and a piece of butter out of an open fridge and set them next to the mixing bowl. The bowl is on a counter far from where the robot starts, so the task needs the base to travel while carrying two separate items.

tasks.n: Carry brewed coffee to dining counter
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must take the freshly brewed coffee from the coffee machine and set it next to the breakfast plate on the dining counter. The dining counter is a long way off, so the robot must drive the base while carrying the full mug steadily.

tasks.n: Move desserts from plates to tray
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must move the dessert items from their plates onto a tray. Several items must be relocated one after another, so the arm needs repeated reliable grasps of food and must end with all desserts on the tray.

tasks.n: Plate drumstick, shrimp and steak
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must take a chicken drumstick, shrimp and a steak out of an open fridge and arrange them on the serving tray on the dining counter. The tray is far from the fridge, so the base has to drive, and three different items must each be grasped and delivered.

tasks.n: Shift items between sink basins
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must move whatever is in the left sink basin over to the right basin for drying, and then put a cup from the counter into the emptied left basin for washing. The two moves are ordered, and the left basin must be cleared before the cup goes in.

tasks.n: Wash lettuce in the sink
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must tip a lettuce from a pot into the sink, turn the water on to wash it, turn the water off and put the lettuce back in the pot. It is a long dependent sequence, and the water has to run for a while before it is switched off.

tasks.n: Put bottled water in the cabinet
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, in a simulated kitchen, must pick a bottle of water up from the counter and place it in an open cabinet. The cabinet is out of easy reach of the start pose, so the robot must first bring the base over before placing the bottle inside.

tasks.n: Add lemon and ice to lemonade
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must take a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl and put both in a glass of lemonade. The lemon is hidden in the closed fridge, and the glass and ice bowl sit on another counter outside the starting camera view, so the robot has to open the door and drive over.

tasks.n: Assemble ingredients for loaded potato
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso, working in a simulated kitchen, must open the microwave, take out a reheated potato and put it, a piece of cheese and a condiment on the cutting board. The potato is hidden in the closed microwave and the board is off to the side, outside the starting camera view, so the robot must open the door and drive to the board.

tasks.n: Stage pans, corn and steak on stove
tasks.t: In a simulated kitchen, a Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a lifting torso must put two pans on different stove burners and then place a corn and a steak into different pans. The placements depend on one another and carry constraints, so the pans have to be on separate burners first and the two foods must not share a pan.

tasks.n: Defrost chicken in the microwave
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso starts at the freezer in a home kitchen and must move a tupperware holding a frozen chicken drumstick into the microwave, close the door and press start. The steps are strictly ordered, since the start button does nothing while the door is open, and the base has to drive across the kitchen between the freezer and the microwave.

tasks.n: Place syrup and honey beside mug
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso, working in a kitchen, must take a syrup bottle and a honey bottle out of an open cabinet and set both down next to a mug. It is a short tidying job with two separate items to fetch, and both bottles must end up beside the mug rather than anywhere on the counter.

tasks.n: Put fish in the oven and close it
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must lay a fish on the pulled-out bottom rack of an oven, slide the rack back inside and shut the oven door. The steps depend on each other, so the fish has to be on the rack before it is pushed in and the door can only be closed once the rack is clear, which makes the sequence hard to recover if an early step goes wrong.

tasks.n: Plate steak and asparagus only
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso must build a steak meal in a kitchen by moving a steak and some asparagus from a tray onto a plate. A chili pepper shares the tray and must stay behind, so the robot has to tell the foods apart and move exactly the right two items.

tasks.n: Split foods into two tupperwares
tasks.t: A Franka Panda arm on a wheeled Omron base with a liftable torso, in a kitchen, must divide the food on a large plate between two tupperware containers so that each one gets a cooked food and a vegetable. The pieces include hot dogs, a mushroom and a lemon wedge, so the robot has to classify each item by type and not just move them in any order.
st: one cooked food and one vegetable
